title: Mini Utopia
tagline: Mini Utopia is a virtual world platform and tool set that allows creators and communities to create and trade their own non-fungible tokens (NFTs) within a next generation metaverse.
description: Mini Utopia is a virtual world platform and tool set that allows creators and communities to create and trade their own non-fungible tokens (NFTs) within a next generation metaverse. This innovative platform is poised to tap into the rapidly growing market for NFTs and the increasing demand for immersive, customizable virtual experiences.
how_its_made: It uses the NFT technology in a decentralised manner with tools which will include c# for the creation of the virtual world , JavaScript for the layouts and web interfaces, solidity for the interactions with the blockchain Technology and the NFT technology that is emerging we will use the ipfs and realted technology as well as the filecoin evm and some corresponding tools to achieve development of a high level NFT technology
